title: Kaiserliche Hofburg Innsbruck
highlights: Bedeutende Habsburger Residenz, von Maria Theresia im Wiener Spätbarock umgestaltet
Prunkvoller Riesensaal mit monumentalen Deckenfresken und Kaiserporträts
Authentisch ausgestattete kaiserliche Appartements und prachtvolle Hofkapelle
Dauerausstellungen zu Kaiser Maximilian I. und Kaiserin Elisabeth (Sisi)
kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserliche Hofburg in Innsbruck delights as a magnificent Habsburg residence featuring the Riesensaal and baroque imperial apartments.
beschreibung:
Imperial Splendor in the Alps

The Kaiserliche Hofburg Innsbruck ranks alongside Vienna's Hofburg and Schloss Schönbrunn as one of Austria's three most significant cultural monuments. Completed under Emperor Maximilian I, Empress Maria Theresia had the palace splendidly remodeled in the Rococo style during the 18th century.

The Riesensaal and Imperial State Rooms

At the heart of the palace lies the monumental Riesensaal, adorned with illusionistic ceiling frescoes and portraits of the imperial family. A tour through the state apartments allows visitors to experience court culture and Habsburg history of the grandest caliber.
